tasks.title: Implement bounded existing Linux-engine recovery
inputs: Existing Release-Roots.ps1 and retained build/test conventions
Accepted scoped architecture at 2f832f564c1b4e9443a2027e848e518eaeecf310 and originating linux-engine-exact-mount-contract disposition
Retained helper/build-input commits 55a60e69df0e053be1b92da3b20d7875245e92e9 and 1eec6d4750c4fff95bb08a047554e03e81c767f5; continue rather than reimplement
produces: Committed deterministic helper and fake-command regressions

Scoped exact expected-mount correction and updated commit/hash/check evidence for original review
acceptanceCriteria: Implement explicit ApplicationRoot/LabRepositoryRoot validation through loaded Release-Roots.ps1. Diagnose only effective selected existing local Docker Desktop Linux context/endpoint and conflicting overrides; reject ambiguous, remote, unsupported, crossed or changed selection without credential/config dumps.

Already-ready Linux succeeds without startup. Otherwise invoke supported docker desktop start at most once only for the attributed existing Linux engine. Bound individual child commands and readiness polling, recheck the same selection, report attempted startup/readiness/elapsed waiting safely, and return nonzero for failed/hung commands or timeout. Exit-zero startup alone is not readiness.

No engine install/upgrade/reset, host/daemon reconfiguration, context/engine substitution, environment-selection mutation or restart of a ready engine. Terminate only attributable owned commands, never the engine or unrelated processes. Do not execute real recovery during Developer work.

Fake-command tests cover ready/no-start, recoverable, failed start, failed readiness, wrong/changing selection, invalid/crossed roots, missing/unsupported tooling and hung commands. Assert no build/publication on failure and no start on ready/unsupported paths. Execute Windows PowerShell cases with the pinned absolute Python; distinguish justified Linux exclusions from execution coverage.

Keep Build-Demo offline with all existing Linux/amd64/hosting-Python, dependency/source/image and separate retained-suite guards. Change only necessary public read-only test-input mounts for the helper, not automatic startup. Run targeted/root/build regressions, applicable retained suite and application/repository checks against explicit roots. Commit scoped source before original Architect/Critic review.

Within test_release_native_settings.py, add only Ensure-LinuxEngine.ps1 to NativeSettingsTests.test_exact_readonly_linux_mount_and_compile_closure_contains_new_helper's exact expected public read-only mount set. Preserve exact equality, duplicate, file-presence, read-only, network, runtime-closure and compilation assertions. Do not skip the failing test, remove the necessary mount or add the helper to the hosted runtime/package closure. Commit the correction with the required Copilot trailer, run the affected regression and applicable retained validation with explicit roots and the pinned absolute Python, and return updated commit/hash/check evidence through original Architect/Critic review. Actual engine startup and Linux readiness are not prerequisites for this source assignment.
